source_text: Omnes nos venire necesse est ad illum ignem; etiamsi Paulus sit vel Petrus. Tales audiunt: non nocebit tibi.
pass_a_gloss: All us to-come necessary is to that fire; even-if Paul there-be or Peter. Such hear: not will-harm you.
pass_b_english: We must all come to that fire — even a Paul or Peter. Such hear: it will not harm you.
